lines.line: Summary: A blue-vest pickup that pads your health against gunfire, explosions and fire; in San Andreas it is shown as a bar rather than as hit points.

quoted: Body Armor is a pickup and gear featured in the Grand Theft Auto series that serves primarily to protect the player's health from specific forms of damage, most notably gunfire.
In most cases, body armor in the games is illustrated as a protective blue vest.
extending the player's resilience to damage from gunfire, explosions and fire
The armor hit points stayed the same until Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas, where the armor is now a bar instead of hit points.

lines.line: Uses: Armor works as padding on top of your health, but in San Andreas it gives no protection from falls.

quoted: The body armor's primary function is to serve as padding for the player health
the armor in GTA San Andreas and GTA Vice City Stories is an exception, providing no protection to the player from falls

lines.line: Where to get it: Ammu-Nation sells it for 200 once the mission Doberman is done, it also lies as a pickup in set places, and climbing into a police or SWAT Enforcer van gives you some.

quoted: Ammu-Nation (3D Universe, GTA Chinatown Wars, GTA V, GTA Online)
200 (GTA Vice City & GTA San Andreas)
Doberman (GTA San Andreas)
In addition to spawning in specific locales, body armor can also be purchased at stores that sell weapons, such as Ammu-Nation, as well as entering the Police/SWAT Enforcer trucks.

lines.line: Summary: A spinning heart pickup that fills your health to its maximum; in San Andreas they turn up during gang wars and in most missions with a lot of gun fights.

quoted: Health pickups scattered around the map can restore the player's health to the maximum level.
health pickups are generally shaped as rotating health icon with the symbol of a heart
In Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas, health pickups appear in San Andreas during gang warfare and in most missions involving a lot of gun fights.
Health is replenished to maximum

lines.line: Uses: Other ways to heal in San Andreas: eat food, step into an Ambulance for up to 20% or a Hotdog van for up to 40%, or save the game at a save point.

quoted: Health can be also replenished by up to 20% when entering Ambulances or 40% when entering the Hotdog van in Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas.
by eating food (in GTA Vice City, GTA San Andreas, GTA IV and its episodes, GTA V and GTA Online)
by visiting a save point to save the game (in all 3D Universe titles, save for GTA III and Grand Theft Auto Advance

lines.line: Tips: Your maximum health can be raised by paramedic side missions and by exercising: sprinting, swimming or going to a gym. If your health runs out you are wasted, taken to the nearest hospital, charged a fee and stripped of your weapons, and any mission in progress fails.

quoted: Health is replenished to maximum, which is a variable scale that can be increased by performing paramedic side missions and exercising (sprinting, swimming, or visiting a gym).

When the player's health is completely depleted, the protagonist is considered "wasted", and is then transported to the nearest hospital, after which a fee for healthcare will be assessed, and all weapons will be confiscated in the 2D and 3D Universes. Any mission that may have been in progress at the time is considered as failed.

lines.line: Summary: Outside a mission you save by collecting the floppy diskette pickup at an available safehouse; saving also restores your full health and skips six in-game hours. The Johnson House is the save point you start with.

quoted: In order to save the progress while not in a mission, the player is required to collect a "floppy diskette" save pickup at any available safehouse
Saving the game also restores the player's full health and skips time in 6 in-game hours.
The Johnson House is provided to the player as the default save point at the start of the game

lines.line: Uses: Safehouses can have a garage for up to four vehicles, a wardrobe for the clothes you have bought, rewards for collectibles, and some pay a daily asset income.

quoted: Garage: A maximum of four vehicles can be stored in any of the garages.
Wardrobe: All clothing items purchased from clothing stores will be available at the player's wardrobe
Collectible Rewards: Items rewarded from collecting specific types of collectibles will be available at certain safehouses.

Daily Asset Income: Certain safehouses are tied to a specific mission strand which, when completed, will render the safehouse as an asset-type property, with a pickup generating a specific amount of money to be collected daily.

lines.line: Tips: To buy one, collect the green house pickup and press the Action button; a blue house pickup is not unlocked yet. If a car will not fit, park a car in the garage door's way so it cannot close, then park the one you want inside. All 37 save points are needed for 100% completion and cost $879,000 in total.

quoted: In order to purchase a safehouse, the player must collect the green house pickup and press the Action button.
Blue house pickups indicates safehouses or assets that are yet to be unlocked for purchase.
The player can park a car in the door's way to prevent it from closing and then parking the desired vehicle in the garage.
Obtaining all 37 save points is a requirement for achieving 100% completion (contributing 15% of the total), costing a total of $879,000.

lines.line: Summary: A spinning star-shaped police badge pickup; each one you collect takes one star off your wanted level.

quoted: A police bribe is a pickup in the Grand Theft Auto series intended to eliminate the player's wanted level.
the bribe appears as a rotating, star-shaped police badge pickup that will reduce the player's wanted level by one star when picked up

lines.line: Uses: Other ways to lose a wanted level in San Andreas: change clothes at a safehouse or clothing shop, respray at a Pay 'n' Spray, modify a car at a Mod Garage, start the Freight Train Challenge or a vehicle school lesson, buy a plane ticket to another city, or finish a mission.

quoted: Wanted levels are removed by:
Collecting police bribes.
Changing clothes at any safehouse or clothing shop.
Respraying a vehicle at a Pay 'n' Spray.
Modifying a vehicle at Mod Garages.
Starting the Freight Train Challenge.
Starting a vehicle school lesson.
Going to an airport and buying a plane ticket to another city.
Completing a mission.

lines.line: Tips: Bribes are scarce, so it helps to memorise where they lie; some sit at a slight height and need a jump in a vehicle. Higher-level police already chasing you, such as the military, SWAT or the FBI, keep coming after a bribe, though no new law enforcement vehicles appear. The exception is the Police Maverick, which gives up at three stars and drops you to two.

quoted: its scarcity makes the tactic more difficult unless the player memorizes their locations
Some require performing a jump in an automobile to reach, as they are positioned at a slight altitude, being inaccessible on-foot.

any higher-level police presence (Military, SWAT or FBI for example) in the area prior to obtaining the bribe will continue to pursue the player (assuming a wanted level is still in place), but no more law enforcement vehicles appear.
The one exception is the Police Maverick, which will disengage from pursuit of a player with a three-star wanted level upon obtaining a police bribe (reducing their wanted level to two stars).

lines.line: Summary: A one-person jetpack that lies on the ground like a weapon pickup and switches on the moment you walk into it; it is dropped when you press the vehicle exit button.

quoted: The Jetpack is a special vehicle in Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas.
it spawns like a weapon pickup when not in use, it is activated instantly when the player walks into it, and is dropped when the vehicle exit button is pressed.
Capacity
1 (operator)

lines.line: Uses: It makes you invulnerable to falling, crashing into walls or moving vehicles, and landing on a moving helicopter. Only one-handed weapons work while you fly it: Pistol, Tec-9, Micro SMG and Sawn-off Shotgun.

quoted: it also makes the player invulnerable to falling, crashing into walls or moving vehicles, landing on top of a moving helicopter and other dangers.
Only the 'one-handed' weapons can be used while the Jetpack is in use, namely Pistol, Tec-9, Micro SMG and Sawn-off Shotgun.

lines.line: Tips: After the mission Green Goo it waits at Verdant Meadows Airfield beside the asset collectible, and it is a great choice for collecting horseshoes around Las Venturas. It has a much lower altitude limit than aircraft and is not ideal for scaling taller buildings.

quoted: After the said mission, the Jetpack will be unlocked and will spawn at the Verdant Meadows Airfield, beside the asset collectible.
The Jetpack is a great choice for collecting Horseshoes in the Las Venturas area.
The Jetpack has a much lower altitude limit than the other aircraft vehicles, and it is not ideal for scaling taller buildings

lines.line: Summary: A shoulder-fired homing launcher. It picks the nearest target itself: the marker is green on a vehicle and turns red after 3 to 5 seconds, which means the missile is locked on.

quoted: The Heat-Seeking Rocket Launcher, sometimes referred as Lock on Missile, is a man-portable infrared homing surface-to-air missile in Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas.

the Heat-Seeking Rocket Launcher automatically selects the nearest available target. When pointed at a vehicle, the marker is green. After waiting for 3–5 seconds, it turns red and the missile is locked on.

lines.line: Uses: It is useful for taking out air vehicles such as Police Mavericks, and the missile flies much faster at aircraft. It can destroy any vehicle instantly.

quoted: making it useful for taking out air vehicles, such as Police Mavericks. The missile's flight speed is significantly increased when the target is an aircraft.
this type of Heat-Seeking rocket can destroy any vehicle instantly.

lines.line: Tips: Fired with no target, the rocket explodes after 100 to 200 meters, and you cannot sprint, jump or crouch while holding it. It lies at Easter Bay Airport in San Fierro, at Mike Toreno's ranch after Vertical Bird, beside an abandoned house in Aldea Malvada, and on a parking lot roof near Pilson Intersection in Las Venturas.

quoted: If shot launched without finding a target, after 100–200 meters, the rocket explodes.
As it is a heavy weapon, the player is unable to sprint, jump or crouch when holding the weapon.
Easter Bay Airport, San Fierro – Between the fuel canisters at northeast
Tierra Robada – Inside Mike Toreno's ranch upon completion of Vertical Bird.
Aldea Malvada, Tierra Robada - Beside an abandoned house
Pilson Intersection, Las Venturas – On the northeast corner of the roof of a parking lot southwest of the intersection

sections.name: Wanted level one and two stars (police)

lines.line: Summary: One star brings an officer on foot, one or two police cars and, in towns, HPV1000 motorbikes. Two stars brings three officers on foot and, on water, Predator boats.

quoted: One officer on foot
1-2 police cars (including the Ranger for the countryside)
1-2 HPV1000 bikes with motor officers (only in urban areas)
Three officers on foot
1-2 Predator boats (on water)

lines.line: Weak points: At one star only one officer at a time chases you, with a nightstick, and the police eventually lose interest and the star fades on its own, unless you are in a police vehicle.

quoted: At a one-star wanted level, one officer at a time will pursue and attack the player with a nightstick.
At this level, the police will eventually lose interest and the player will eventually lose the wanted star on its own, except if they are using a police vehicle.

lines.line: Tips: From two stars officers shoot even if you are unarmed or holding a melee weapon, and police cars may appear at intersections to block you. Being busted fails any mission, strips your weapons and costs $100 at one star or $200 at two.

quoted: Officers that spawn during this wanted level onwards will now shoot to attack, even if the player has a melee weapon or is unarmed.
starting with this wanted level, while driving through cities, police cars may spawn at certain intersections, attempting to intercept or block in the player's vehicle.
any mission the player was on will count as failed, and the player is transported to the nearest police station, stripped of all weapons and a small amount of money, ranging from $100 to $1,500.
It results in a $100 fine if they player gets arrested
It results in a $200 fine if the player gets busted.

sections.name: Wanted level three and four stars (SWAT, Police Maverick)

lines.line: Summary: At three stars a Police Maverick helicopter arrives and drops SWAT members armed with Micro SMGs, and police occasionally set up armed roadblocks. At four stars SWAT chase in Enforcer vans and a News Chopper joins the Maverick.

quoted: A Police Maverick is called in to provide air support and drop SWAT members armed with Micro SMGs.
occasionally set up armed roadblocks on main roads
At a four-star wanted level, the pursuing Police Maverick is joined by a News Chopper. SWAT teams will give chase in Enforcer vans alongside the regular police cars.

lines.line: Danger: Four-star roadblocks are made of the heavier Enforcer vans, which are harder to ram through. Shooting down the News Chopper only gets it replaced by another Police Maverick, so two police helicopters chase you.

quoted: Roadblocks now consist of these heavier and larger SWAT vans, making them more difficult to ram through.
If the News Chopper is shot down by the player, it will get replaced by another Police Maverick and the player is now pursued by two police helicopters. This increases the danger.

lines.line: Tips: From three stars police motorcycles give way to cars and officers start to appear on the sidewalks when you are on foot. Entering a region or city you have not unlocked gives four stars at once. Being busted costs $400 at three stars or $600 at four.

quoted: Police motorcycles are supplanted (replaced) by police cars at this wanted level
Police officers will also begin to spawn on the sidewalks when the player is on foot.
This wanted level is automatically triggered when the player enters a region or city that they have not unlocked.
It results in a $400 fine if the player gets busted.
It results in a $600 fine if the player gets busted.

lines.line: Summary: At five stars the FBI takes over most of the chase: eight officers on foot (regular, SWAT and FBI), three FBI Ranchers or police cars, Predator boats on water, one or two Police Mavericks, and two Hydra jets if you are in the air.

quoted: Eight officers on foot (regular, SWAT and FBI)
Three FBI Ranchers or police cars
Three Predator boats (on water)
1-2 Police Mavericks
Two Hydra jets (air and Vortex pursuit)
the local police are supplanted (replaced) by FBI agents which takes over a majority of the chase.

lines.line: Weak points: Their Rancher roadblocks are relatively easier to ram through, but the agents can make short work of your vehicle and drive very aggressively, which makes it easy to crash and lose control.

quoted: The roadblocks now consist of FBI Ranchers. Though these are relatively easier to ram through, the FBI agents can make short work of the player's vehicle.
The agents also drive very aggressively while they pursuit the player's vehicle, making it easy to crash and lose control.

lines.line: Tips: The agents carry fast-firing SMGs. Entering or flying over Area 69 or Easter Basin Naval Station gives five stars at once, but the areas around them only give four stars before they are unlocked. Being busted costs $900.

quoted: The FBI agents are armed with SMGs, which have a high fire rate.
This level is automatically triggered by entering or flying over a restricted area, which includes Area 69 in Bone County, and Easter Basin Naval Station in San Fierro.
If the player instead enters the areas surrounding these landmarks before they are unlocked, they will only get four stars.
It results in a $900 fine if the player gets busted.

lines.line: Summary: At six stars Military soldiers with M4s chase you in Barracks OL trucks and Rhino tanks, alongside officers, Predator boats on water, Police Mavericks, and three Hydra jets if you are in the air.

quoted: the player is pursued by the Military soldiers armed with M4s and driving Barracks OL trucks and Rhino tanks.
Ten officers on foot (regular, SWAT & soldiers)
Three Predator boats (on water)
1-2 Police Mavericks
Three Hydra jets (air and Vortex pursuit)

lines.line: Danger: The soldiers have very high precision and fire rate, the tanks may try to crush you, and the roadblocks are Barracks OL trucks with troops, which are very hard to ram through. That makes it nearly impossible to survive for long on foot.

quoted: The soldiers have a very high precision and fire rate with their weapons. Also, the tanks may sometimes decide to crush the player. This makes it nearly impossible to survive for a long time on foot.
The roadblocks now consist of Barracks OL trucks and troops, making it very hard to ram through.

lines.line: Weak points: The tanks only chase and never fire their cannons. A car that hits a tank is only set on fire, not blown up at once, which gives you a chance to get out and keep escaping.

quoted: the tanks are only used to pursuit and they never fire their cannons.
If the player's car hits a tank, it will only be lighted up on fire but not immediately explode, which allows for a chance to exit and continue escaping.

lines.line: Tips: Six stars is not handed out instantly without cheats, which makes it very hard to reach; the level opens up after Yay Ka-Boom-Boom and in practice can be reached after Learning to Fly. Being busted costs $1,500.

quoted: The six-star wanted level becomes available after C.R.A.S.H. allows access to Las Venturas with the completion of Yay Ka-Boom-Boom. In practice, it is attainable after completing Learning to Fly.
This wanted level is not instantly obtained in the game without cheats. This makes it very hard for players to achieve this wanted level.
It results in a $1,500 fine if the player gets busted.

lines.line: Summary: From four stars, if you are in an aircraft or a Vortex, two Hydra jets chase you and try to shoot you down with heat-seeking missiles.

quoted: Once the player attains a four star wanted level or higher and is in an aircraft or in a Vortex, two Hydras will pursue and try to shoot down the player.
enemy Hydra planes will chase the player and attempt to shoot them down using heat-seeking missiles.

lines.line: Weak points: They tend to fly in lazy circles and do not use flares, so they often crash into buildings when they fly over cities.

quoted: The enemy Hydras should be no match, as they have a penchant for flying in lazy circles and not deploying flares, and as a result they will easily crash into buildings when flying in cities.

lines.line: Tips: Flying a commercial AT-400 or a cargo Andromada brings none. If you fly a Hydra yourself, dropping its white flares can steer their missiles away, but a flare dropped too early or too late may not work.

quoted: flying an AT-400 or an Andromada will not spawn any Hydra in the sky.
The Hydra can deploy white flares that will deviate incoming heat-seeking missiles from enemy Hydras at high wanted levels
Deviating the flares is not always guaranteed to work, as dropping one too early or too late may render it ineffective.
The only exception to this is the AT-400, which is a commercial plane, and the Andromada, a cargo plane.

lines.line: Summary: The largest and most powerful gang in Los Santos and Grove Street's bitter rival. Their colour is purple, and they come in four sets: Front Yard, Rollin' Heights, Kilo Tray and Temple Drive.

quoted: The Ballas are the largest and most powerful black/Afro-American street gang in Los Santos and have a bitter rivalry with the Grove Street Families.
The Ballas come in four sets – Front Yard Ballas, Rollin' Heights Ballas, Kilo Tray Ballas and the Temple Drive Ballas.
their gang color being purple

lines.line: Weapons: They are usually unarmed or carry Micro SMGs and 9mm pistols, but in a gang war with them they have AK47s, SMGs, shotguns, 9mm pistols, Micro SMGs and baseball bats, and in some missions Tec-9s.

quoted: They are either unarmed or carry Micro SMGs and 9mm pistols, but when in gang wars with them, they have AK47s, SMGs, shotguns, 9mm pistols, Micro SMGs, and baseball bats. In some missions, they are equipped with Tec-9s.

lines.line: Tips: Killing three of their members on foot in an area you want to take starts a gang war, the area flashes red on the radar, and they attack in three waves. Stock up on health, armor and ammo first, watch the radar to see where they come from, and shoot from long distances or rooftops if you can.

quoted: One must enter an area that they wish to control, and kill every opposition member in sight.
Killing three members on foot will provoke a gang war, and the area under attack will flash red on the radar. The opposition attack in three waves to defend their land.
Keep a close eye on the radar, and watch where the attackers are coming from.
having a plentiful supply of health and armor, as well as plenty of ammo for weapons before starting the war is recommended. If possible, shoot from long distances or from rooftops.

lines.line: Summary: A large, powerful Mexican gang in the far north and east of Los Santos (Las Colinas, East Beach and Los Flores) who wear yellow bandanas and are known to attack in large numbers.

quoted: The Vagos are a large and powerful Mexican Los Santos street gang that sport yellow bandanas, and occupy a majority of the far north and east areas of Los Santos, namely Las Colinas, East Beach, and Los Flores.
They are known to attack in large numbers.

lines.line: Weapons: They are unarmed or carry 9mm pistols; in a gang war they also have Micro SMGs, SMGs, AK47s, shotguns and baseball bats, and in some missions Tec-9s and M4s.

quoted: They are either unarmed or carry 9mm pistols. During a gang war, they are also equipped with Micro SMGs, SMGs, AK47s, shotguns, and baseball bats. In some missions, they are also equipped with Tec-9s and M4s.

lines.line: Tips: They are sworn enemies of the Varrios Los Aztecas and also enemies of Grove Street and the Ballas. A gang war against them comes in three waves, so have health, armor and ammo ready first.

quoted: They are sworn enemies of the Varrios Los Aztecas, but are also enemies with the Grove Street Families and Ballas.
The opposition attack in three waves to defend their land.
having a plentiful supply of health and armor, as well as plenty of ammo for weapons before starting the war is recommended.

lines.line: Summary: A small-time Mexican gang based in El Corona, Little Mexico and Unity Station, recognised by turquoise bandanas.

quoted: The Varrios Los Aztecas are a small-time Latin/Mexican Los Santos street gang based in the barrios of El Corona and Little Mexico in addition to Unity Station
distinctly recognized by their turquoise bandanas

lines.line: Weapons: They are unarmed or carry 9mm pistols and Micro SMGs.

quoted: They are either unarmed or carry 9mm pistols and Micro SMGs.

lines.line: Tips: Cesar Vialpando, a gang veteran, is a friend of CJ, but the gang is hostile and may attack CJ and his gang unprovoked. The San Fierro Rifa also wear turquoise bandanas, so do not mix the two up: the gangs are violent rivals.

quoted: Gang veterans include Cesar Vialpando, Jose, Sunny, Gal and Hazer.

Despite the fact that Cesar, a high ranking member (who may also be the leader), is a friend of the protagonist, this gang will be hostile towards the player and may attack CJ and his gang unprovoked.
They can also be identified by their turquoise bandanas, much like the Varrios Los Aztecas (but not to be confused with them, as they have a strong violent rivalry).

lines.line: Summary: A Mexican/Hispanic San Fierro gang that holds Garcia, Doherty, King's and Battery Point and is led by T-Bone Mendez.

quoted: The San Fierro Rifa are a Mexican/Hispanic San Fierro street gang that controls the areas of Garcia, Doherty, King's, and Battery Point.
T-Bone Mendez is the leader of the Rifa.

lines.line: Danger: The least harmful gang in the game: they are unarmed or carry just 9mm pistols, and they are known for running away from CJ when they feel threatened.

quoted: They are either unarmed or carry just 9mm pistols
They are the least harmful gang in the game.
They're known for running away from CJ when they are feeling threatened

lines.line: Tips: They will often ask CJ about his gangbanging status, and if you answer positively they will attack. They wear turquoise bandanas like the Varrios Los Aztecas but are strong rivals of them.

quoted: will often question CJ about his gangbanging status. If the player chooses to respond positively, they will attack.
They can also be identified by their turquoise bandanas, much like the Varrios Los Aztecas (but not to be confused with them, as they have a strong violent rivalry).
